description: Bicycle rear derailleur specifications extracted from Two Wheel Tools (2wheeltools.com), with a primary/secondary source attached to every entry. Fields (optional ones omitted when unknown): brand, model, series, type (MTB/Road/Gravel), introduced (model-year introduced), discontinued (model-year discontinued, present only when known), cage (length code), nominalSpeeds, pullRatio, electronic (Di2/AXS/eTap/etc.), and three sprocket-range specs: maxLow (largest rear cog the cage can reach), minLow (smallest recommended largest cog), capacity (total chain-wrap capacity = front-chainring difference + rear range; max usable front-chainring spread for a given cassette is capacity - (maxCog - minCog)). sourceType: primary = manufacturer/official doc, secondary = authoritative third party.
